notes: AI Find works on large drawing sets again, and shows progress while Engineer Monkey prepares the sheets. New: Find Text builds a layer from circuit numbers, layers can be merged, and a find no longer offers symbols another layer already counts.

features: Find Text: search the drawing's text - a circuit number, a tag - and turn every hit into a layer (Detect > Find Text)
Merge layers: select two or more layers and fold them into one, without double-counting marks they share
A find no longer re-offers symbols an existing layer already counts, so re-running Find, or running Find then AI Find, cannot double-count
AI Find now shows Engineer Monkey's progress while it prepares a drawing set, instead of sitting on one label
fixes: AI Find no longer fails with 'did not finish rendering in time' on large drawing sets
A drawing set is prepared once instead of re-rendering on every AI Find and after every app launch
A preparation that times out is resumed rather than started over, and cannot hang twice as long as it used to
Filtering a dense takeoff no longer stalls the interface for several seconds
